executiveSummary: tallchairadvisor.com has strong impression volume (99,415 over 90 days) but a critically low site-wide CTR of 0.24%, driven primarily by one page — /knee-pain-seat-depth/ — which alone accounts for 41% of all impressions at a catastrophic 0.04% CTR. Title and meta length violations are widespread, with several pages exceeding the 60-char title and 155-char meta caps. A spec discrepancy on /chairs/steelcase-leap-plus/seat-height/ (title states 15.5"–22.5" but body says 15.5"–20.5") undermines E-E-A-T on a key spec page. Several low-click pages in positions 7–10 represent high-priority CTR leak fixes that could meaningfully move revenue.
